issues.desc: Background still defines success mostly by engineering mechanisms (drift fixed, registry added) instead of a crisp maintainer-facing outcome such as how a Koala operator will know lifecycle changes are now safer and easier to reason about.

CHK-003 and CHK-004 are coherent as V1 foundation work, but they do not yet state a directly observable V1 payoff for the requester; tie them to a visible maintainer outcome (for example lifecycle fact changes becoming single-source and drift surfacing immediately) so the story does not read as registry work for its own sake.
